cards.title: SSO login fails for new users after v1.2 deploy
cards.description:
New users provisioned via SAML after the v1.2 deploy cannot log in. Existing users are unaffected.

Error in browser: `Invalid SAML assertion — missing NameID format`

Regression introduced in v1.2 — NameID format handling changed.

checklist.text: Check SAML assertion diff between v1.1 and v1.2

comments.body: Affects ~30 new users provisioned since Monday. Existing users unaffected.
comments.author: demo1

cards.title: API returns 500 on bulk card export
cards.description:
## Reported

POST `/api/boards/{id}/export/` returns HTTP 500 when the board has more than 500 cards.

## Steps to reproduce

1. Open board with 600+ cards
2. Click Export → CSV
3. Response: `500 Internal Server Error`

## Impact

Blocks weekly reporting for all 12 teams.

comments.body: Reproduced. The export query times out at 30s — no pagination on that endpoint.
comments.author: demo1

comments.body: Fix: stream the CSV in chunks. MR open, awaiting review.
comments.author: demo2

cards.title: Board load time regression after v1.2
cards.description:
Large boards (800+ cards) are taking 4–6 s to load since v1.2. Previous baseline was ~1.5 s.

Profiling points to a new `get_member_roles()` call in `BoardFullSerializer` that runs once per member.

comments.body: Confirmed N+1: 14 extra queries for a 14-member board. Fix is straightforward.
comments.author: demo1

cards.title: Webhooks not firing on card moves
cards.description:
Globex has a Zapier integration that listens for `card.moved` webhook events. Since Tuesday, events are not being delivered.

Webhook logs show events queued but not dispatched. Worker appears healthy.

checklist.text: Send test payload to Globex endpoint

comments.body: Worker is running but Redis queue is backed up — unrelated deploy caused slowdown.
comments.author: demo1

comments.body: Awaiting Globex to confirm their endpoint is ready to receive test payload.
comments.author: demo2

cards.title: Feature request: CSV export include archived cards
cards.description:
Customer requests that the CSV export include archived cards with an `is_archived` column.

Currently, archived cards are silently excluded from all exports.

checklist.text: Log as feature request in backlog

comments.body: Workaround communicated. Feature filed as #287 in backlog.
comments.author: demo1

cards.title: Permission error when creating swimlanes
cards.description:
Board members with Member role get a 403 when trying to add a swimlane, even though the board is configured to allow member-level swimlane creation.

Regression: this worked before v1.1.

comments.body: Reproduced. The v1.1 permission refactor accidentally tightened swimlane creation to Admin-only.
comments.author: demo1

cards.title: Labels not persisting on card edit
cards.description:
When a card is edited and saved, labels are cleared. The UI shows them momentarily but they disappear after the API response.

Observed in Chrome and Firefox. Not reproducible in Safari.

checklist.text: Check PATCH payload includes label IDs
Verify serializer handles partial update for M2M

comments.body: The PATCH payload is correct. The serializer is not saving M2M on partial=True — known Django quirk.
comments.author: demo1

cards.title: Email notifications for @mentions not delivered
cards.description:
Users are not receiving email notifications when @mentioned in card comments. In-app notifications work correctly.

Mail logs show the notification task is enqueued but no SMTP activity.

checklist.text: Check Celery worker is running email tasks
Test SMTP connection from worker host
Confirm customer SMTP allowlist includes our IP

comments.body: SMTP test from worker succeeds. Suspecting IP allowlist issue on their side.
comments.author: demo1

comments.body: Awaiting Pinnacle IT to confirm their allowlist — sent instructions.
comments.author: demo2

cards.title: Resolved: browser cache causing stale board state
cards.description:
Customer reported boards showing cards in wrong columns. Root cause: browser cached the old board snapshot.

Resolution: hard-refresh clears the issue. Added cache-busting headers to the board API response.

checklist.text: Add Cache-Control: no-store to board endpoint

comments.body: Deployed in v1.2.1. Customer confirmed resolved.
comments.author: demo1

cards.title: Board export missing checklist data
cards.description:
CSV and JSON exports do not include checklist items. The API response includes them, but the export serializer omits them.

Impacting their reporting workflow.

comments.body: Quick fix — checklist_items just needs to be added to the prefetch and serializer.
comments.author: demo1

cards.title: SAML assertion fails intermittently (1 in 20 logins)
cards.description:
~5% of SAML logins fail with `InResponseTo mismatch`. Affects all users, not just new ones.

Suspicion: clock skew between their IdP and our service. Their IdP is on-prem; NTP sync uncertain.

checklist.text: Check NTP sync on their IdP
Widen our SAML clock tolerance to ±5 min

comments.body: Their IdP has a 4-min clock drift. Widening tolerance is the right fix.
comments.author: demo1

cards.title: WIP limit not enforced when dragging from archived view
cards.description:
Cards restored from the archived panel bypass WIP limit checks and are placed in the destination column even when the limit is exceeded.

The restore endpoint does not call the column's WIP validation.

checklist.text: Add WIP check to restore endpoint

comments.body: Fixed in v1.2.1. Restore now respects WIP limits.
comments.author: demo1

cards.title: Compliance audit — provide access logs for Q1
cards.description:
Vertex requires a full access log export for Q1 2026 for their internal compliance audit.

Needed: timestamp, user, action, resource for all board operations.

CardMovement history covers moves; other actions need a separate pull.

checklist.text: Confirm scope with Vertex compliance team

comments.body: They need the raw data, not a UI report. Will export directly from DB.
comments.author: demo1

cards.title: Historical card movements not visible in History tab
cards.description:
Cards moved before 2026-01-01 show no movement history. The History tab displays 'No history yet' for these cards.

Root cause: the CardMovement table was introduced in v1.0 — older moves have no records.

checklist.text: Check if any legacy activity logs can be imported

comments.body: Expected behaviour — pre-v1.0 moves were not tracked. Communicated to customer.
comments.author: demo1

cards.title: Data export times out on board with 2,000+ cards
cards.description:
The JSON export endpoint times out (30s Nginx limit) for their largest board. The board has 2,100 cards across 8 swimlanes.

Fix: implement streaming export with chunked transfer encoding.

checklist.text: Increase Nginx timeout as temporary mitigation

comments.body: Temporary mitigation: bumped Nginx timeout to 120s. Streaming fix in progress.
comments.author: demo1

cards.title: Resolved: increased Nginx timeout for large exports
cards.description:
Interim resolution applied: Nginx proxy timeout increased from 30s to 120s for the export endpoint.

Permanent fix (streaming export) tracked in engineering backlog.

checklist.text: File permanent fix as engineering ticket

comments.body: Customer confirmed export now completes (~45s). Permanent fix tracked separately.
comments.author: demo1

cards.title: Onboarding: how to bulk-import cards from CSV?
cards.description:
New customer asking about the bulk import feature. They have 300 cards in a spreadsheet they want to load.

Point to: Settings → Import → CSV template.

cards.title: Mobile: cards overlap on small screens (< 375px)
cards.description:
On iPhone SE (375px wide), cards in the board view overflow and overlap adjacent cards in the same column.

Reproducible in Chrome DevTools mobile emulation.

checklist.text: Fix column min-width on mobile breakpoint

comments.body: Confirmed. The column grid doesn't collapse below 400px. CSS fix needed.
comments.author: demo1

cards.title: Drag handle unresponsive in Firefox 124
cards.description:
Card drag-and-drop stops working after the first successful drop in Firefox 124. Subsequent drag attempts do nothing.

Root cause: Firefox handles `pointermove` differently when a CSS transition is active on the column.

comments.body: Confirmed in FF 124. Disabling the column resize transition during drag fixes it.
comments.author: demo1
